TO UNBLOCK: an unbounded accumulator would end static decidability — `maxLookback` could no longer be a tree sum and the repaint verdict could no longer be decided before the tree runs — so it is not a backlog item. `closedTable.json::_no_offset_reopened_by` names who may re-open that (the repaint-claim owner and the manifest owner, together). Re-seeding the value at a stated window turns it into `accum`, which translates today — `dnBand` builds on its own previous bar and this engine cannot tell that it ever forgets where it started, so folding it would draw a rolling window over the last 250 bars rather than a running total. THIS ENGINE DOES DECLARE A BOUNDED FORM: `lowest(<that value>, <bars>)` — the lowest over a window you name. Stating the window is what makes the answer the same tomorrow — an all-time value moves with however many bars were fetched.
